prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: HAND-DRAWN CONCEPT MASTER for three original shipborne machine roles belonging to the human ark GUIHANG, not a finished game render.
Make one coherent professional Japanese mecha design sheet on ivory drafting paper, 1536x1024 landscape, three clear columns with full-body three-quarter drawings and generous margins. Precise pencil/ink contour, subtle construction lines, restrained marker colors, lively yet legible mechanical design. Main palette shared with mother ship: warm-white armor, slate blue-gray frame, dark graphite flexible depths, sparse brick-red identity panels and amber service catches. Tiny neutral human scale silhouettes, no exact dimensions or fake technical paragraphs. Labels only EXPLORER / SENTINEL / HARVESTER.
LEFT EXPLORER: non-humanoid compact observation machine. Low flat sensory torso, one recessed horizontal optical sensor bar, two articulated survey outriggers with dish/antenna ends, two compact sampling claws under the body, tiny vectoring thrust pods, short docking skids. No conventional airplane nose or wings, no full human legs, no cartoon face. Frame can fold into a small serviced package. Delicate and precise, clear instrument modules, no gun.
CENTER SENTINEL: original 20-meter-class humanoid protective combat/work frame. Synthesize layered industrial mecha skeleton, elegant wrapping chest/forearm armor and role-specific maneuvering equipment into ONE original coherent design. Low flattened faceless sensor head recessed in a high protective collar, NO forehead horns or V-fin. Forward-wrapping rounded chest shell over mechanical rib cage, protective shoulder roots with visible elbow/knee mechanisms, balanced waist, strong but relatively agile legs, short broad feet. Two compact replaceable back-thruster pods, small calf nozzles; no huge wings. Left forearm has an angular tool-shield with a U-shaped rescue attachment recess and protected tow point. Right hand holds a simple short fictional carbine lowered; military equipment is understated. Do not use recognizable Gundam head/chest blocks, Tekkaman horns/crystals/lance, or an existing Mecha BREAK silhouette. Elegant armor coverage belongs to a serviceable machine, not a supernatural suit. No glowing magic core.
RIGHT HARVESTER: non-humanoid low broad industrial core, two thick front anchoring arms ending in padded rock clamps, plus two secondary articulated tool arms (one enclosed mechanical cutter, one material gripper), removable ore cassette seated in the aft chassis, short stabilizing grapples and compact maneuver thrusters. Exactly FOUR main arms with clear joints and routing, not a pile of random limbs. Dense mechanical effort at tools, quiet armored central volume; reads as a heavy work machine, not a tank or animal.
All three share paired rectangular capture lugs and a visibly standardized dorsal or ventral maintenance saddle, repeatable service access plates and attachment markings. Distinct silhouette and function even without labels. Small patches and worn grasp points imply work, never luxurious chrome. NO space scenery, portals, foliage, large guns, projectile detail, brands, franchise emblems, UI, photorealistic CGI or dimension claims. This is an art-development sketch plate, not a production drawing.
